audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this lane was never stated anywhere on the page: Null Sphere (Q) interrupts channels, and Breath of Light is a channel. Kassadin ends your beam on demand from 650 range.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Kassadin Q: 'Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Cooldown 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, range 650. Owner Q Breath of Light carries the channel flag. So every step-up inside 650 with Null Sphere available is a cancelled channel plus a shield on the damage you did land.
audit.corrected: Stated across tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dontsFull[0], whys[0], early and wants.foe[0]: channel only once Null Sphere is spent, and W-flyby from outside 650 is the one trade he cannot cancel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributes a silence to Force Pulse in four places ('Force Pulse's silence', 'Silence and poke with Force Pulse'). Force Pulse has no silence — it is a 400-range cone that damages and slows, on a 21/20/19/18/17 cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's text for Kassadin E: 'Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.' Derived flags list only slow. The interrupt effect belongs to Null Sphere, not Force Pulse, and it is an interrupt rather than a silence.
audit.corrected: Every 'Force Pulse silence' reference replaced with the real mechanic — Null Sphere's channel interrupt at 650, and Force Pulse as a 400-range cone slow that arrives around level 4.
sources: brief enemyKit E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty framing described a generic assassin lane and, in the content layer, an Aurelion Sol that no longer exists ('wide star orbit', 'stacked stars', 'Q comet', 'long-range ultimate ... global threat').
audit.why: Owner kit is Breath of Light (750 channelled beam), Astral Flight (1500 travel, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16), Singularity (750, 12s, percent-health execute) and Falling Star (1250 range, 120/110/100 — not global). Kassadin's Void Stone also reduces magic damage taken, which taxes the owner's entire kit and was never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Reframed as a range lane: he must cross 500 with Riftwalk to reach a 750 beam, Void Stone shaves your damage, and Falling Star's job is to punish the arrival. Removed the pre-rework 'stars' language and the false 'global' ultimate.

notes: IMPORTANT — I deliberately did NOT use one of the supplied missingInteractions. It claims 'Your Astral Flight (W) shuts off Kassadin's Riftwalk (R) — hold it for the engage, not the poke.' That is derived from a terrain flag on Astral Flight that contradicts Riot's own description: 'Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction.' Astral Flight does not CREATE terrain, so it cannot wall off a dash. The flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire and the claim would have been a fabricated interaction on a live page. Also worth knowing: Kassadin's Null Sphere no longer silences in Riot's text — it interrupts channels — and the page's repeated 'Force Pulse silence' was wrong on both the ability and the effect. Level chart: full phases[2/5/6].side disagreed with content win[] and with packet.levelChart on three rows; fixed the full layer to match, and lowered phases[5].rating and phases[6].rating so the difficulty numbers agree with the new verdicts. The existing whys for those three rows already described the owner winning, so no why rewrite was needed there.
